# Foundation Business OS & Zero-Build Web Platform

> Foundation is a zero-build JAMstack platform providing e-commerce, media streaming, course delivery, and backoffice tools.

## Core Endpoints & Pages
- Main Site: [https://foundation-5b8.pages.dev/](https://foundation-5b8.pages.dev/)
- Storefront Catalog: [https://foundation-5b8.pages.dev/shop](https://foundation-5b8.pages.dev/shop)
- Platform Documentation: [https://foundation-5b8.pages.dev/docs](https://foundation-5b8.pages.dev/docs)
- Sitemap Feed: [https://foundation-5b8.pages.dev/sitemap.xml](https://foundation-5b8.pages.dev/sitemap.xml)
- RSS Broadcasting Feed: [https://foundation-5b8.pages.dev/rss.xml](https://foundation-5b8.pages.dev/rss.xml)

## Interactive Capabilities
- Searchable Storefront: Real-time product search and checkout via Stripe and Web3 crypto wallets.
- Universal Royalty Engine: Automated percentage splits for contributors on content and merch.
- Web Radio & Video Portal: 24/7 continuous stream audio player and gated VOD video portal.
